_comment: Pinned open-weight reranker catalog (TD-SELECTOR-1 gate 5). One entry per (model, version) provenance pin: the artifact sha256/size are the content-addressed identity, the uri records where the export lives (outside the repo — models are 22.7M-parameter binaries), and the io spec is the serving contract OrtTokenizedScorerSession binds. version pins the UPSTREAM revision the export was produced from, so an evidence claim (BENCHMARK_EVIDENCE.toml) and the serving artifact stay joined at the hip.
